avis.texte: I received this product as a gift and could not be happier !! I used it as toner and it cleansed my skin , followed with a moisturizer and I feel like it dried out a few of my breakouts

I use this AHA treatment a few time a week instead of regular toner. It definitely exfoliates the skin giving the smooth and bright skin surface. It does tingle a little but i don't see any reaction from my skin. Works good and will continue using this.
I love how this AHA treatment smells and feelson my skin. Also how soft and smooth my skin is since I started using it. I've noticed my skin looks brighter and has glow with fewer acne breakouts now.

I have had KP on my upper arms since I started puberty. It comes and goes, and normally hasn't been too bad in my life, but in the last 2 years it's become a huge problem to the point I don't wear short sleeves or tank tops anymore. It certainly doesn't help that I haaaaave to pick at my bumps. I've cause so much inflammation and scarring bc of it. I use an AHA body wash daily, and a duo acne/retinol lotion 2-3x per week. They help a little, but I was looking for something more. I love Korean skincare and was looking forward to trying this brand. I finally decided to buy bc it came with a sample of the hyaluronic essence (which I love btw!). I have used maybe 1/5 of the bottle so far. I started with 2x per week as the instructions say, but my arms are not nearly as sensitive as my face so I increased it to every other day. LADIES my KP is almost completely gone. I'm shook. I didn't expect it to help THIS MUCH. This is now a staple in my skincare routine and I am completely sold on this brand. I'm in love I tell you! If you are new to AHA products just be aware there is a slight tingly sensation. AHAs also increase sensitivity to the sun so make sure you're wearing and reapplying SPF! I am so happy with this product I could cry.

I really love Hanskin and what I've tried by them. I really enjoy the bubble line and this product is awesome!! I have combo, sensitive and acne prone skin. I usually use and prefer acids (bha, aha and pha) in a Toner or Serum form since I'm sensitive and react to alot if I am not careful. I have never had an issue with this toner. It's not drying, helps combat my acne and keep it at bay, helps reduce size of my nose pores, helps even my tone and redness and has been gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I always use immediately after double cleanse and then follow with a hydrating toner, serum then moisterizer after. I use on a cotton round and swipe across face targeting my chin, nose and forehead mainly. I had a little tingle burn (as it does have acids in it) in the beginning when I first started but nothing that moisture can't fix and rid of. I use about 3x weekly and has been great.
I usually get very pink and irritated with exfoliants but not this one. Def does everything it claims
I've been using this product for about 3 weeks now and I am a fan. It exfoliates my skin and also hydrates and soothes it as well. It has not broken my skin out, and I will be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Great treatment for those starting out with exfoliation!
avis.texte: I have acne and pigmentation from past breakouts resulting in uneven skin tone and texture. After one month of using this consistently throughout the weeks (1-2 times per week) I noticed a smoother complexion overall. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a gentle yet effective treatment.

I used this product 2-3 times a week for over a month. The first time I used it I noticed a slight tingling sensation which was due to the AHA in the product. My skin adapted well to it, however, and the only side effect was slight redness. This became unnoticeable over time. My pores were getting smaller and tighter, and the overall appearance of my skin looked clearer and brighter.

I've been using this about once a week to see how my skin would react as my skin's been rather unpredictable lately. No adverse reaction so far and my skin feels clean and fresh after use so I'll be upping the frequency to 2-3 times a week. There is an initial tingling but it's not drying. I look forward to the upcoming results.

Absolutely cannot get enough of this product! I struggle with dry and sensitive skin, so I'm very picky when it comes to skin care products!! This exfoliator is gentle and doesn't sting. After using this for two weeks, I've noticed visible improvements with my skin. I've seen less texture on my face, smaller pores, and it makes my skin look plumpy and well hydrated. I threw out my other chemical exfoliators because I can't get enough of this product! Hanskin products are life changing.

I've been using this for a month now and it's been very nice even for my easily irritated skin! My skin instantly feels more hydrated and soft after using this in my night time routine. I've seen some improvement with texture as well so I'm excited to continue using!!

I've been using this for a month now and it's been very nice even for my easily irritated skin! My skin instantly feels more hydrated and soft after using this in my night time routine. I've seen some improvement with texture as well so I'm excited to continue using!!

avis.titre: I would buy and recommend this product!
avis.texte: I use this product 1x-2x a week. If you plan to use it in the morning, be sure to follow up with your typical serums, moisturizer and sunscreen! At night time, follow it up with your serums and night time moisturizer. Worked really well for me and have noticed my blemish scars have lightened up within 2 weeks or so.
I was surprised because it made my skin glow rather than dry it out and make it irritated. Very happy
First time using this and I have enjoyed this product very much. It did not dry my skin or irritate it. Would recommend
Works great as a toner. The cap is a little hard to release so i took it off and it's much easier to use! There's a slight tingling but gentle enough for my sensitive skin!
I've been using this for a little over a month now and I've seen a great difference! It's a great exfoliator and has left my skin looking glassy and dewy. Highly reccomend!

I have used this product once or twice a week to help even out my dark spots and minimize my pores. There is a slight tingling sensation after your swipe this on your face but that is normal. Since using this for almost 3 weeks, I have notice a slight change in skin tone and smoother looking skin. I hope it continues to improve as I continue using it. Just remember to moisturize afterwards to prevent your skin from drying out.

I've used the Hanskin Hyaluron Exfoliating AHA Treatment in the past with minimal changes to my skin texture. I've since taken a break from chemical exfoliators and haven't been the best at upkeeping my skincare routine. I decided to try this product again after my face started experiencing some buildup and acne, and it definitely balanced out my skin texture! It's still not a holy grail for me, but I'm willing to keep giving it a try when my skin feels out of whack. I gave my brother a second bottle; he uses it sparingly but is also satisfied with the treatment.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel so smooth!
avis.texte: I really like this product! I use it 1-2 times a week after cleansing and it makes my skin feel extra soft and smooth. 👍🏻👍🏻

I'm just getting into skincare products and I was recommended this product. I appreciate it having dual use as a toner after cleansing and it's little perks like lightening dark spots! I really like it so far and it makes me feel good. :)

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I have not used an AHA product before. I like this product because I feel it working. The downside to this is I felt a slight tingling especially in acne spots. My skin felt smoother and refreshed after using and I enjoyed the very light clean fragrance since it was very mild. My only suggestion is to fix the plastic cap dispenser. The cap did not allow any liquid to pass through so I had to remove it which makes it much harder to control the flow amount usually dispensing too much.

This Hanskin product did not disappoint. I have also used their Skin Essence, and both that and this product do a great job of hydrating my dry skin. I apply this product right after I wash my face with cleanser. It absorbs quickly into my skin. I have been using it every day for a few weeks now and the bottle looks barely used.

OKAY. So I work in the food industry and just being around the heat of the grills and fryers and wearing face masks, I've become prone to mask acne and I honestly wasn't having it. I use this product every Thursday & Sunday after I clean my face and I've seen miraculous results. I would consistently have pimples around my mouth area, nose, and wow, really helped my skin. ALSO, some people may not like the tingly sensation, but I... I kinda like it. It just feels good after a long day tbh.

After about two weeks of trial with the product, I did notice some brightening of my skin the next morning after I used the product. My skin is normal (not necessarily dry or oily) and sensitive so I used this product at night and only once a week considering the high concentration of AHA. The toner itself is pretty lightweight and loose as well as hydrating. I appreciate the different amounts and weights of derivatives of hyaluronic acid that balances out the treatment well. Keep in mind this product was gifted to me, but I enjoyed it nevertheless.

I love how this product is so gentle on the skin! I know we can get scared off by the word "exfoliating" but rest assured your skin won't be irritated. After two weeks of use I've definitely noticed smoother skin and shrinking of my pores. The only downside is it's not super nourishing. It doesn't strip skin but I wish it felt a bit more moisturizing after use.

I have used my fair share of exfoliants to combat my stubborn acne scars. This exfoliant, by far, is the most gentlest AHA exfoliant I've used. It does leave a slight tingly feeling, but it isn't as uncomfortable as other competing brands. After using it for 2 weeks, I have noticed a difference in my complexion - it's much smoother and my acne marks aren't as dark.

I love this product. I use this as a toner before all my other products. It's more gentle than other exfoliating treatments. I notice my skin is more hydrated and pores appeared smaller. My skin is brighter and some spot has lighten. I love Hanskin products and this is definitely one of my staples on rotation! Highly recommend!!!

This treatment was so gentle on my sensitive skin, which is pretty hard to come by for an exfoliating product. It does sting a little, but not in a way that burns. I use it after I wash my face in the morning and it's improved my skin texture and noticeably brightens my complexion. It's definitely a good addition to my skincare routine!
Overall I think this product works but it's a little to string for me. I have really sensitive skin so I only use it once a week. It seems to even my skin out pretty well.

I used this toner twice a week for a few weeks straight and did notice smoother and less oily skin. I've been more oily especially in the summer and I felt like this toner helped control my oils. It tingles lightly when applied and I would recommend using it sparingly and with a light hand. I think I applied too much pressure when swiping it across my skin at one point and I did end up stripping some skin and burning my cheek a bit. I stopped using the toner for a week in that specific area to let my skin heal and just continued use more gently. My skin feels tighter, smoother, and less oily.

avis.titre: Buy it, try it, and believe in it
avis.texte: What an amazing product! You really just have to buy one and try it out. Definitely did make a huge difference within my skin. After 2 weeks of using it, it started to show some difference. Just like the instruction says, only use x1 or 2 throughout the week. Don't overuse it or else it'll just ruin your skin instead. Give it a try and honestly, this product last a while.

avis.titre: Good addition to weekly routine for oily and sensitive skin
avis.texte: I liked using this product for my night-time routine twice a week. It can be tingly for certain sensitive areas, but after a couple of weeks of use, my skin adapted. Because I'm oily, I didn't feel like it dried me out too much - I think it actually helped offset that. Be patient - it worked well for me.

I use this at night after using my cleanser. I don't always use it everyday but so far I love it! I have sensitive skin and this works really well. I also use the hanskin moisturizer after it which is a great combo.

This works well but I have really sensitive skin and it's pretty strong. So I only used it once a week. It seems to exfoliate my skin pretty well. But I think if I use it to often it may irritate my skin. So if you don't have extremely sensitive skin I think it will work well.

Great product! Its gentler than other AHA treatments and can be used as a toner after cleansing! It helps with lightening dark spots and discoloration. One downside is its a bit harder to saturate the cotton pad with this product. Be sure to use a good moisturizer and sunscreen as well!

Good product— works as an exfoliating toner after face cleansing. Surprisingly gentle on the skin. Because of the AHAs it brightens some dark spots and discoloration! Long term use daily would probably show a significant difference! Doesn't sting as much as other comparable products I have used! Overall a good product for those with skin discoloration issues or for those who wax their face!
Very soothing to skin after applying and I use it twice a week. So far it hasn't irritate my skin and smooths it as well.
Good exfoliating toner that leaves your skin fresh & clean. The light scent is nice too.

avis.titre: Tingly feeling but feels great! Perfect for my skin!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over 2 months now and I use it regularly. I only use once a week and it gives it that tingly feeling after you put it on, but then it goes away pretty quickly. It doesn't hurt my face but I love that theres a tingly feeling so I know it's working. Very easy to use once a week, just put on a cotton pad and then wipe on your clean face. Would def recommend to my friends who needs some skin quenching.

i enjoyed using this product. i remember trying it for the first time after reading about the tingling sensation because of the AHA. it felt so good! after using this product i'd go in with a vitamin c serum and moisturizer, while still only using it for 1-2 days a week. helped with my mask acne breakouts that i've been getting recently.

avis.titre: Exfoliating that isn't harsh on your skin
avis.texte: I used this product once a week and since I have more sensitive skin, I use it at night just so my skin isn't more exposed to the sun during the day after using the product. There is a slight tingly feeling after using the product and I use serum and moisturizer soon after! This product has been a great exfoliator! I normally used exfoliators with the miniature beads, but this is a great alternative. My skin has definitely been feeling smoother after a month of use and my skin has not been irritated by it at all! It has been a great add to my weekly skin routine.

I love to use this product during the night time as it gives me that glory skin right after. What is even better and shocking is that the next day my face feels a lot smoother and not heavy at all. I would definitely recommend this to anyone regardless the sensitivity of their skin!
Gentle for my sensitive skin. Has a slight tingling feeling when you first apply and quickly goes away. I've been using this product for about 3 weeks now and notice a better texture to my skin tone.

I love using this product- my skin is looking really good lately due to the combination of this treatment and the Hanskin essence. The light tingly sensation is totally normal! It's really good at getting all the gross stuff off my face and I see that my skin looks soo nice the days after I use it. I use the product twice a week per the instructions!

avis.titre: A great chemical exfoliator for beginners
avis.texte: I'm a long-time user of chemical exfoliators, including the active ingredients of this product, glycolic and lactic acid. I stopped using other acids while trying this treatment out 1-2x/week as recommended. There was only a mild stinging when i had open wounds (i.e. I picked at my acne... oopsies) but other than that I found the treatment to be gentle. I don't think that my skin drastically improved or felt any smoother than it already is since I was already using chemical exfoliators more than twice a week, which are probably at a higher concentration than the Hanskin Exfoliating AHA Treatment. I would recommend this product if you haven't had much experience using AHA/BHA treatments since it is so gentle :)

I don't know if it's just me, but my experience with 'exfoliating' has always been the face cleansers with those little beads inside it, and you abrasively rub them into your face to get rid of dead skin. This treatment instead was just some droplets on a soft cotton pad. I felt a slight tingly sensation, but in no way was it stinging. I think you don't need to use that much on it. It says it does a 4 in 1, exfoliating, skin boosting, hydrating and soothing- I've only used it for a couple weeks (1x a week), but so far my skin feels softer and hydrated! I've heard exfoliating is good to do once a week and so this definitely outplaces any other kind of exfoliater I've used.

avis.titre: gentle and non-drying; my face looks more clear
avis.texte: I've been using this product twice a week for about 4 weeks and I have noticed that my skin looks more clear; fresh. It does tingle a little bit but it doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. I'll definitely keep using this treatment. It really does seem like it reboots my face on the nights I use it.

This product is great! It does all the things it says it does. I don't usually get the "tingly" sensation when I use it, it's more of a cooling feeling as it dries. I like that it does help remove any left over dirt after washing your face and doesn't dry your skin out. It has a light scent that I enjoy and leaves my face super soft!
I used this once a week for the past few weeks, and it's very gentle. I've seen my skin look brighter and more moisturized, but it's also pretty subtle.

After cleansing face, I apply a few dabs on a cotton pad and gently wipe skin. After the tingly feeling goes away, I apply eye cream and moisturizer. Sometimes I use my serum drops before moisturizer. I only use it 2x a week (DIRECTIONS SAY ONLY USE 1 or 2x a week). Ever since I started using this product, I have not been breaking out. I started noticing that glass skin effect and my pores have gotten noticeably smaller. My skin is very sensitive; therefore, I was hesitant to try this but now it is part of my daily routine. I have used this product for about a month. On the days that I don't use this product, I use a facial mist instead of a toner. *If you have super dry skin, I would use it only once a week and apply a lot of moisturizer and serum after.

I have actually only used this product twice so far without anything other than CeraVe salicylic acid cleanser and the moisturizing cleanser and I can say my acne scars are starting to go away. The product also smells really good!

I've been using this acid toner for the past few weeks and really like it! My skin is quite used to chemical exfoliants so I found this to be quite gentle and left me with glowy smooth skin. Definitely kept in my daily routine - I don't have any major hyperpigmentation so I can't speak to that piece, but have not found this to be irritating at all.
I've been using this product once a week and am definitely starting to notice the glass skin effect on my skin. It does leave a bit of a tingle so use sparingly. Great product!

Another great product by Hanskin! You can instantly feel the product working. My skin has been dry and peeling because I starting using retinol. Once I started using this product my skin feeling more hydrated and peeling less. Definitely will be keeping this in my skin routine.

I have been using this with the bubble cleanser that hanskin also has. Been loving the combination so far. I have ketosis pilaris and I sometimes use this to exfoliate my arms. Would recommend this to a friend!

Even with one swipe, this exfoliator gives the skin a glowing radiance the next day. It is pretty powerful, so using it no more than 2-3x a week, as advised, can be irritating. I have some eczema patches on my face and this did not over irritate them when used 2x a week. The Hyaluron aspect also adds to making the face supple and plump. This is one of the best hydrating and exfoliating treatments I have used!!

avis.titre: Great exfoliating treatment for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: Great twice a week treatment! Reading the instructions before using, they mention a slight "tingle" can happen while using, which I was slightly worried about with my sensitive skin, but thankfully I worried for nothing. There is some stinging in the problem areas (especially if you use too much product), but goes away quickly. The product has seemed to help dry out and get rid of some of my acne quickly, without over drying the skin, which is amazing! A fan of Hanskin products, i'm happy to add this to my weekly routine.

This exfoliating treatment is great for improving your skin texture! The results aren't immediate, but after a couple weeks of consistent use, it does make your skin feel softer. Be sure to only use a little at a time. The first time I used it, I made the mistake of using too much, and the stinging sensation lasted quite a while. And as with all Hanskin products, it's super gentle on sensitive skin!
This Exfoliating Treatment leaves the skin hydrated and smooth. I like using it as a toner after cleansing my face at night.

I am so obsessed with HANSKIN!! I literally started using them a few months back when pandemic started and it's one of the best skincare brands out there! I feel my face getting softer and softer! I literally use the whole line from toner, to exfoliater, to night cream to herbal day cream! This exfoliate is great for my skin because it actually does feel softer and more moisturized. The weather has been harsh on my skin but this definitely makes it better! If you only try this exfoliate, I would suggest you buy the rest of the skin care line. It does help!

I have been loving Hanskin lately! This is the 3rd or 4th product of theirs that I've tried and they've continued to impress me. I've been using this treatment twice a week for the past month and it's been a nice addition to my skincare routine. It's not irritating at all and gives my skin a nice pick me up.

i used this product twice a week and yes, i did feel a mild stinging sensation (not bad at all) and yes, it was soothing and hydrating... however, i didn't see any drastic outstanding results that would make me highly recommend this product to a friend.

I applied this thin liquid using a cotton round. It has a light pleasant smell and I've used it by itself and with a moisturizer afterwards. So far having used it a few times there's been no skin irritation. At first I didn't notoce any difference in skin but it did feel a bit smoother the second and third time and went well under moisturizer. I went back and forth between giving this a 3 or 4 star but since my skin can be sensitive and it hasn't irritated it, and there is some smoothing, I'll keep trying it.

avis.titre: Best kept secret to glass skin!
avis.texte: I am seriously obsessed with all Hanskin products and this hyaluron exfoliating AHA treatment is amazing! Been using it for a few weeks and I can tell my pore are smaller and tighter. My skin is so hydrated and plump! Perfect for the cooler months. I highly recommend this product amd give it a try. Also great on sensitive skin!
I have rough textured skin and this helps exfoliate away my small bumps
This product is good! It was soothing and hydrating on my skin. It is not irritating to the skin and I didn't break out at all which I loved!!

avis.titre: A lightweight and clean feeling exfoliant
avis.texte: This treatment is very lightweight - smells nice and doesn't feel oily or overly heavy which I like. It's important to remember to only use once or twice a week!

This product is great for people who have sensitive skin. I have a really hard time finding treatments and exfoliators that won't irritate my skin. But this is a great product to smooth out the skin while keeping it moisturized and not irritated. Please note to not pour too much onto the cotton pad because it is strong if you use a lot!

I am wary on exfoliating my face with products in general since I have very sensitive skin, but tried this since it is k beauty and does not seem to have any harsh chemicals in their line. I have tried their other cleansers and loved how gentle it was. When i tried the AHA treatment, i was blown away how well it paired with my skin and exfoliate without any reactions. Will definitely be including this into my routine!

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I've loved the results so far. My skin is pretty sensitive but I did not have any allergic reactions after using it. I use it 2-3 times a week right after I cleanse. My skin feels really hydrated and smooth afterwards. There's no harsh scent either. I would recommend this to anyone looking for an AHA exfoliator!

Super hydrating and perfect for my sensitive skin. Great for winter months where my skin has a hard time exfoliating on its own! I usually have super dry skin and this didn't bother my skin at all. I'd definitely add this on my skin regimen!

I really love this product. It is super hydrating and goes on very smooth on my skin. I have super sensitive skin and this did not break me out. It kept my skin feeling smooth and glowly. It really feels nice and it smells really good. I would get this product again!

It's really hard to find an at home chemical exfoliation that is safe and effective! I would be very careful with this if you have sensitive skin (I'm a practicing esthetician) I have dry skin with some sensitivities and I knew right away this is a one time per week product. That is all you need though!! This so far is a great product & I'm excited to see more people try it and review it.

Y'all are sleeping on this! It's the most expensive product in my routine, but I'll definitely be buying it again when I run out. I have super sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate it at all. I didn't realize the directions say to use it twice a week, but I haven't had any irritation using it once a day. My skin is so bright and smooth, and it smells wonderful.

i've been using this for a couple of weeks and wow has my skin transformed! it hydrates my skin and reduced the texture on my forehead. overall my skin has never been so smooth and redness has definitely decreased. a painful whitehead that would've lasted a week to disappear, was gone overnight when i used this. also this bottle will last me a long time so great purchase!

I have combination skin that shifts from oily to dry very quickly and suffer from acne here and there. I found this to be moisturizing and non-stripping and kept oil at bay. It also minimized the redness around my nose and helped even my skintone over a 2 week morning+ every other night day routine. Ingredients are also amazing with no fragrance and fillers.
